requirement: Exactly one organization, instance, environment, and attachment must exist.
Required Google APIs must be present and retained during destroy.
The Apigee organization must use the cloud runtime.
The Apigee organization must use an explicit authorized VPC.
Configured CMEK values must be full Cloud KMS CryptoKey resource names.
Runtime networking must use private RFC1918 /22 address space.
The Private Service Connect consumer allowlist must not be empty.
Runtime access logging must be enabled.
The Apigee environment tier must be explicit and supported.
The API proxy type must be explicit and supported.
The deployment type must be explicit and supported.
A configured forward proxy must use HTTPS and an explicit port.
Client-IP resolution must use a trusted, nonzero X-Forwarded-For index.
